correctness.rationale: Exact factorization of the weighted strain forces and coordinatewise exchange cancellation proves the finite-time identity. Physical state invariance and monotonicity follow from the explicit Euler step bound. At criticality the stable transverse residual divided by total force contracts and the reciprocal total increments converge to h*K/d; Cesaro averaging proves the exact 1/k law. Above threshold, monotone sub/supersolutions and uniqueness of the scalar endemic force yield global attraction. Varying one susceptible coordinate in the putative universally conserved positive weight proves every row of B is proportional, i.e., the iff rigidity. CHECK.py passes three exact rational regimes and threshold numerics. Finite checks are supporting evidence only.

originality.rationale: The new claim is not the general existence of a neutral coexistence simplex or the generic 1/k center-manifold law. It is an exact finite-time weighted strain-share selection, an all-node affine exchange identity, a complete parameter threshold trichotomy, a model-specific universal critical per-strain profile, and the converse if-and-only-if matrix rank characterization. The source model paper does not supply these. The closest published rank-one study explicitly excludes proportional strain profiles. Material comparison is stronger than an absence of keyword hits, but uninspected full text and unindexed equivalences remain risks.
residual_risks: Full texts of arxiv:2111.07507 and arxiv:2303.16457 could contain an equivalent weighted-invariant selection on the degenerate contact sector; only their abstracts were accessible in this run.

Indexed search and checked prior records cannot certify worldwide novelty or independent priority.

value.rationale: A neutral continuum alone is insufficient to predict a strain composition from nonuniform node-level infections. The conserved contact-weighted share selects the exact endpoint, an affine formula resolves its transient imbalances, and the critical limit gives each strain an exact population-specific clearance coefficient. The necessity half identifies a natural complete rank-one boundary for this form of conservation across all states; this is a structural classification with direct network-dynamics meaning rather than an arbitrary tiny parameter gain.
